old_description: Garment Supplier, Support, Designing, Engineering, Engraving, Setup, Jet Printed Fabrics, Prototyping,
about:
Finetex Textile Group operates from Lebanon, Pennsylvania, where it provides full-service textile manufacturing and fabric printing. The company's leadership includes David Hammond as vice president of manufacturing and Maria Hammond in customer support, alongside Chad Zhang. No founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The facility handles all types of fabrics and printing methods, offering roll-to-roll heat transfer sublimation printing merged with roto gravure technology, plus cut-and-sew operations with no minimum or maximum job size. Services span designing, engineering, engraving, setup, jet-printed fabrics, and prototyping, allowing customers to move quickly from concept to production.

Finetex serves apparel brands and licensees seeking licensed art and color reproductions on fabric, producing items such as children's shorts, briefs, and gym shorts. Its customer base includes companies needing rapid product-to-market cycles while developing their own patterns.

The company emphasizes its ability to manage every stage of textile production under one roof, from artwork reproduction to finished garment assembly, positioning itself as a single-source partner capable of handling any job size without imposing minimum order constraints.

name: Finnegan Health Services
old_description: Premium products, outstanding service, and private delivery to your doorstep.
about:
Finnegan Health Services operates from Conway, Arkansas, tracing its roots to 1983 when Finnegan Pharmacy opened in Little Rock. The family-owned business evolved into a dedicated durable medical equipment (DME) provider in 1994, expanding statewide to serve Arkansas Medicaid and Medicare patients.

The company supplies a broad range of home healthcare products — including incontinence, urinary, nutritional, ostomy, wound care, bath safety, walking aids, diabetic testing supplies, tracheostomy and suction equipment, gloves, and safety items — delivered directly to patients’ doors. It handles insurance verification and billing for Medicare, Medicaid, private commercial plans, TEFRA, and Medicaid PASSE programs, and offers an online referral portal for healthcare professionals and families.

Finnegan serves children, elderly, and disabled individuals across Arkansas who require insurance-covered medical essentials. Its customer base includes Medicaid and Medicare beneficiaries, privately insured patients, and healthcare providers who refer patients for coordinated DME support. Testimonials highlight service to families managing type 1 diabetes, wound care, and other chronic conditions.

Founded on a mission to “empower health and enrich lives,” the business grew from a community pharmacy into a statewide DME supplier by focusing on compassionate, personalized service and simplifying the complexities of insurance coverage for patients and providers alike.

name: Fire Mountain Solar LLC
old_description: Fire Mountain Solar tailors solar systems and electrical services to give you the choices you want and need, on the grid…and beyond.
about:
Fire Mountain Solar LLC is based in Mount Vernon, Washington, and has been operating since 2001. The company was founded by the Nelson family, with co-owner Alana Nelson playing a key role in establishing the Solar Installers of Washington and serving in leadership positions with the Washington Solar Energy Industries Association. The business began with the design of an off-grid power system for the founders’ remote property, giving the team hands-on experience that still informs its work today.

The firm provides a full range of solar and electrical services, including consulting and system design, full-service installation, DIY solar support, backup power solutions, and ongoing service and technical support. Its expertise spans grid-tied, off-grid, and hybrid systems with battery storage, and it also supplies equipment such as solar panels, inverters, batteries, charge controllers, and mounting hardware through its online shop. The company does not disclose facility size or employee count.

Fire Mountain Solar serves homeowners, businesses, and remote-property owners across Washington and beyond. Project examples include off-grid cabins in the San Juan Islands, residential installations on Camano Island, and DIY support for a customer in La Grange, Texas. The company works with both new construction and retrofit projects, and offers remote consulting for clients outside its local service area.

The company distinguishes itself through its deep involvement in shaping Washington’s solar industry standards, its breadth of experience across simple and highly customized systems, and its philosophy of educating customers before selling. As a family-oriented, locally rooted business, it emphasizes long-term relationships and transparent communication, positioning itself as a partner rather than a transactional contractor.

name: First Cable Line Inc
old_description: Superior and a leading position in the market as the trusted manufacturer of high-quality cable assemblies.
about:
First Cable Line, Inc. was founded in 1993 in Arcadia, California, where it maintains its headquarters and a stocked facility. The company operates as an electronics manufacturing services (EMS) provider under the leadership of General Manager Michael Lin, with additional production sites in three countries that give it a geographic advantage for global customers.

The company delivers full turnkey manufacturing, ranging from custom cable assemblies and wire harnesses to printed circuit board assembly using surface-mount and through-hole lines, metal stamping, and complete contract manufacturing. Its Arcadia location carries a large inventory of standard data and networking cables, while the offshore facilities extend capacity for higher-volume runs.

First Cable Line serves a broad industrial base that includes telecommunications, military and aerospace, audio and video, automation, cloud data storage, intelligence/surveillance/reconnaissance, consumer electronics, and industrial machinery. Customers range from OEMs in consumer electronics to defense contractors requiring specialized harnesses.

The firm emphasizes a “total quality system” backed by UL, ISO 9001, and QS-9000 certifications, along with RoHS and WEEE compliance. It positions itself as a one-stop shop that can accelerate time to market through rapid quoting, design-for-cost improvements, and on-time delivery.

about:
First Card Packaging, a family-owned and operated business based in East Providence, Rhode Island, has served the packaging needs of companies large and small for over 30 years. The company emphasizes personal attention that distinguishes it from larger competitors.

The company produces a range of custom packaging products, including jewelry cards, tags, tickets, labels, boxes, inserts, point-of-purchase displays, loss-prevention packaging, supply items, and specialty designed products. Its six-step process guides clients from project conception through final inspection and shipment, with production scheduling and sampling available.

First Card Packaging works with businesses across the jewelry and retail sectors, counting brands such as Shawn Paul Jewelry and Float Jewelry among its customers. The firm serves both large and small companies, tailoring solutions to each client’s branding and packaging challenges.

Founded on a commitment to service that extends from the sales desk to the shop floor, the company differentiates itself by assigning representatives who spend time understanding each customer’s unique needs and collaborating with the production team to refine solutions based on feedback.

name: Fisher Hawaii
old_description: American Express, Samsung Pay, Apple Pay and Google Pay at our Store Locations!
about:
Fisher Hawaii operates from Honolulu, Hawaii, where it was founded in the 1920s as the first office product warehouse in the United States. The company remains locally owned and operated, serving the islands through three locations on Oahu.

The business functions as a full-service retail and commercial office products warehouse, stocking more than 50,000 items across its facilities. Its flagship Mapunapuna warehouse spans over 20,000 square feet, the Kaka'ako location covers 17,000 square feet with 60-plus parking stalls, and a downtown Honolulu store provides additional retail access.

Customers include office managers, teachers, small business owners, artists, students, and educators. The company supplies office and home office furnishings, arts and crafts materials, education and school supplies, and general office products to both commercial and retail buyers.

Fisher Hawaii attributes its longevity to a focus on "serving people" and a commitment to "Bringing You More," emphasizing wide selection and low warehouse prices.

name: Flathau's Fine Foods
about:
Flathau's Fine Foods operates from Petal, Mississippi, where it bakes shortbread cookies, cheese straws, and snack products daily for nationwide shipment. The company has earned recognition since at least 2003, when its Peppermint Snaps won a Best of Atlanta award. Heather Flathau has been honored with the Governor's Award for Achievement in Exporting in 2016 and 2018, indicating leadership involvement.

The product line centers on all-natural shortbread cookies sold under the Flathau's Fine Snaps and Maddy's Sweet Shop brands, with flavors such as Key Lime, Lemon, Butterscotch, Cinnamon, Peppermint, and Raspberry. The company also produces cheese straws, including a Cheddar Chipotle variety, and Robicheaux candy. Operations include daily baking, packaging in tins, boxes, and subscription boxes, and fulfillment for direct-to-consumer, wholesale, catering, private-label, and corporate-gifting orders. Products are shipped nationwide from the Mississippi facility.

Customers range from individual consumers ordering online to retail stores, hospitality venues such as the Treasure Bay casino in Biloxi, and corporate clients seeking branded gifts. The company lists a wholesale program and offers catering services, indicating a food-service channel. Awards from the Specialty Food Association and features in Real Simple magazine reflect a specialty-food and gift-market focus.

Flathau's Fine Foods emphasizes that its shortbread cookies are made with all-natural ingredients, positioning them as a guilt-free indulgence. The company highlights its catering, private-label, and corporate-gifting capabilities as extensions of its core baking business. A long list of awards, including SOFI Awards, Artisan Flavor Awards, and multiple Best of Atlanta honors, underscores a competitive differentiation based on flavor innovation and quality.

name: Fleetwood Electronics
old_description: We’re a full service electronics manufacturing and electronics engineering company, providing everything from PCBA to fully assembled, drop shipped product. Your design or our design.
about:
Fleetwood Electronics operates from Holland, Michigan, as a full-service electronics engineering and manufacturing company. The firm provides end-to-end services from printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) to fully assembled, drop-shipped products, working from either customer designs or its own original designs.

The company maintains 100% in-house capabilities, including PCB assembly, custom test development, final assembly, packaging, and drop shipping. It also offers original design manufacturing, handling hardware, firmware, and web dashboard development. Fleetwood supports products through FCC and UL certification processes and provides serialized component-level traceability for high-voltage or line-powered devices. No facility size, headcount, or volume figures are published.

Fleetwood serves a range of sectors including hospital safety and personnel tracking, commercial construction, food service, wireless industrial lighting control, environmental monitoring, asset tracking, eLearning, medical research data collection, telepresence, smart lighting control, power line monitoring, and direct-to-consumer products. A noted customer is Domico Med-Device, for which Fleetwood manufactured the Instant-Trace™ system, a 2022 finalist in Michigan's Coolest Thing Made contest.

Fleetwood emphasizes that its value proposition spans the full product life cycle rather than lowest cost, citing on-time and on-budget delivery of PCB assemblies, in-house custom test development, and the ability to take a product from concept to market in as little as two months.

name: Flex-Cable
old_description: This email address is being protected from spambots. You need JavaScript enabled to view it.
about:
Flex-Cable traces its roots to 1961, when the company opened its first plant in Troy, Michigan, supplying cable products to the automotive industry. Operating as Northern Cable and Automation Company, LLC, the business later expanded to a larger manufacturing facility in Howard City, near Grand Rapids, while maintaining corporate offices in Birmingham. The privately held LLC is HUBZone certified, a designation that supports reduced lead times and close customer collaboration.

The company produces a broad range of electrical connectivity solutions, including custom cable and wire harness assemblies, robot dress-out packages, furnace and resistance welding cables, motion control cables, bus bars, and copper stampings. Its manufacturing capabilities span injection molding, metal fabrication, custom machining, and custom over-molding, with specialized IP65/69-rated connector housings made from self-extinguishing thermoplastic. Proprietary technologies such as pre-formed bus bars for electric vehicles, air-purge cables, and flat cables with a 2.5-inch bend radius reflect a focus on innovation.

Flex-Cable serves automotive, defense, manufacturing, automation, robotics, healthcare, and electric-vehicle markets. Its customer base extends across the United States, Canada, Mexico, Europe, and the Middle East, with the auto industry remaining a core segment since the company's early approval by Detroit manufacturers.

Differentiators cited by the company include a continuous-improvement culture targeting zero defects, ISO 9001 and IATF 16949:2016 quality certifications, a manufacturing defect warranty, and HUBZone status that enables responsive service for both short- and long-term projects.

old_description: Flexpak has the capability to create a package for anything. Any size, shape, design or quantity.
about:
Flexpak Colorado operates from Aurora, Colorado, and maintains facilities across the United States. The company has over 25 years of experience in packaging solutions, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not provided in available sources.

The company provides custom packaging design and manufacturing, packaging equipment and automation integration, distribution of thousands of packaging products and facility supplies, and custom foam and mold fabrication. It partners with suppliers to deliver the latest packaging automation technology. Flexpak describes itself as one of the West's largest and fastest-growing packaging companies, with a national footprint through its membership in the Packaging Distributors of America.

Flexpak serves a broad range of industries, citing examples from aerospace (rocket motors) to food and beverage (root beer). Its customer base includes businesses that ship, display, or sell products requiring custom packaging solutions. The company's national presence allows it to service customers across multiple sectors.

Flexpak differentiates itself through a service philosophy it calls "Expect Extraordinary," pledging never to lose a customer based on service. The company also commits to a 21% absolute reduction in Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions by 2029 from a 2024 baseline, aligning with the Paris Agreement goals.
